description: Kainz, Samuel and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The German energy-system and Wikinger case estimates a time-dependent marginal displacement factor in greenhouse-equivalent emissions per unit of wind generation. Generation mix and demand-supply conditions affect the displacement estimate. Wake steering for power maximization is assessed for its environmental value. The analysis concerns incremental avoided operating emissions and does not establish a complete life-cycle footprint. Source results depend on the represented grid and time period, and cannot be generalized to other electricity mixes without recalculation. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The appraisal is based on linking wind-farm generation to marginal grid-emissions estimates.
